name: specsket
description: Analyze project briefs, research products, stage evidence-backed proposals, and perform explicitly confirmed vendor authoring when the connected MCP permits it.

interface.shortDescription: Project intelligence and product sourcing workflows
interface.longDescription: Tag Specsket Workflows Beta for project intelligence, product research and ingestion, supplier onboarding, or governed vendor authoring. Enable the separate Specsket MCP Tools Beta connection for live schemas and permissions. When its capabilities and callable tools permit, explicitly confirmed vendor reviews can create or activate companies, update settings and private drafts, import owned media, edit vendor products, and separately publish products or storefronts. Product-ingestion and supplier proposals remain human-review workflows. Claims require human proof; invitations are not sent.
defaultPrompt: Find a fast shortlist of products for my project
Analyze these project briefs into rooms and layered requirements
Normalize and stage these product or supplier records
